description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for 'User' documents in a MongoDB collection, including fields for referral information, authentication, and timestamps, with various indexes and schema options to handle heterogeneous data.

classes.name: ReferralHistoryItemSchema
classes.description: A subdocument schema for flexible referral history items with various fields such as user ID, email, name, referral dates, and status.

classes.name: UserSchema
classes.description: Main schema for user documents, including authentication info, referral data, timestamps, and indexes.

methods.name: pre('findOneAndUpdate')
methods.description: A pre-hook to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp before executing 'findOneAndUpdate' operations.
